bounds: No Flutter/DSH Go app exists in this workspace: the native panel is proven against the upstream protocol schemas, the view budget walk, the manifest gate and service doubles. A device install is the reader's check.
HTTP route guards beyond the host fence are unit-proven against a server double (the fence answers before a bare request reaches 405/400/413), exactly as the team watchdog's routes are.
The relay's fallback behaviour is proven when nobody else answers; the desktop-plus-phone case is 'the desktop wins' by construction, not by a live two-answerer run.

The closure gate has no arm for a byte-DIFFERING file inside a required directory entry, and an invented extra file inside an artifact dsh-go is not detected (pre-existing scope of the manifest rule).

mpd-team-core's action routes reuse the team plane's existing mount seam without the watchdog's per-server WeakMap tracker: the read routes register in the same call untracked, so a second tracker would diverge.
